gcodeErrors.notSetting: “{{variable}}” isn't a setting this slicer knows (it may come from another slicer or a newer version).
gcodeErrors.unknownName: it uses a name this slicer doesn't know.
gcodeErrors.negativeIndex: “{{variable}}” is read before the first filament is loaded (its index is -1 there); check that index with {if ...} first.
gcodeErrors.negativeIndexList: a list is read before the first filament is loaded (its index is -1 there); check that index with {if ...} first.
gcodeErrors.stoppedOne: Slicing stopped: a custom G-code can't be filled in.
gcodeErrors.stoppedSome: Slicing stopped: some custom G-code can't be filled in.
gcodeErrors.fix: Fix it in the {{where}}, or reset it to the preset's G-code.
